text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `rdw-inference-hosted-prod` - PRIORITY: P1 - API error rate spike detected, paging `platform-oncall`
Priya Kapoor: anyone else seeing this look like a wrong-target page? alerts are about dedicated routing failures not hosted API
Alex Chen: yup, this is the dedicated pool. PD rule matching by tag regressed after yesterday's config rollback. the tag key changed from `infra:dedicated` -> `service_role:dedicated` so the selector missed it
Izzy Morales: acked (oncall). I'm seeing increased 5xx from four pods in ashburn. Can someone confirm expected responders?
PagerDuty Bot: Alert acknowledged by Izzy Morales
Sam Barton: this is definitely misrouted. we should reroute to `dedicated-inference-oncall` while we patch the PD rule. suppressing platform pages temporarily to avoid noise
Morgan Lee: I can run the reroute now. executing:```sh
pd service reroute --from platform-oncall --to dedicated-inference-oncall --service rdw-inference-hosted-prod --until 2026-03-13T23:00:00Z
```
PagerDuty Bot: Reroute successful — incidents reassigned to `dedicated-inference-oncall`. Current escalation: Izzy Morales -> Morgan Lee -> Alex Chen
Priya Kapoor: thanks. Izzy, what's customer impact right now? which customers impacted?
Izzy Morales: three tenants (acme, beta-inc, labco) seeing ~10-20% request failures for short tails. errors are `kv-cache-miss` followed by `model-serving-timeout` in logs. no PII or data leak. CS notified with heads up
Alex Chen: root cause: our rollback removed the tag sync change in the deployment pipeline (pipeline 2.4.1). PD rule still matching old tag key. safe fix: update PD rule to match both keys and revert the pipeline change to reapply `service_role:dedicated` tag
Sam Barton: temporary mitigations: 1) reroute (done), 2) increase retry/backoff for affected route, 3) enable prefix cache warming for dedicated pool (low risk)
Morgan Lee: on it. I'll push the PD rule change now (small patch). Patch:```yaml
- match: "infra:dedicated"
+ match: ["infra:dedicated", "service_role:dedicated"]
```
Priya Kapoor: assign owners & timeline please
Izzy Morales: monitoring for next 30m, will escalate if error rate doesn't drop below 1% of baseline
Alex Chen: I'll open a hotfix for the pipeline tagging rollback (deploy safe revert) — ETA 2h
Morgan Lee: PD rule patched and deployed. verifying with test alert...
Incident Bot: Test alert routed to `dedicated-inference-oncall` (OK)
Priya Kapoor: looks good. Izzy, can you confirm error rate trend?
Izzy Morales: error spike trending down to ~3% in last 10m. latencies returning to normal for 2 tenants, remaining tenant has intermittent timeouts. continuing watch
Sam Barton: adding manual throttling on the problematic tenant for now to avoid queue buildup
Morgan Lee: created follow-up ticket PD-1234 (pd-rule-regression) and linked to infra rollback PR #482. owners: Priya (PD rules), Alex (deploy fix), Morgan (postmortem), Izzy (monitoring/bridge)
Priya Kapoor: postmortem items: - tighten canary for pipeline tag changes - add PD rule unit tests to CI - run monthly PD-rule audit - ensure oncall rotation has override runbook
Izzy Morales: agreed. will draft initial impact summary for customers and ops update
Alex Chen: once everything is stable, let's close this thread. thanks all for quick action :thumbsup:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident silenced by Morgan Lee
Priya Kapoor: closing note: no customer data impacted, service availability degraded for small set for ~45m, action items filed PD-1234 and PR-482. follow-up postmortem owners assigned.
Sam Barton: adding retrospective timeline to the ticket.
Morgan Lee: marking incident resolved in PD and will kick off postmortem doc later today. :white_check_mark:
